newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, trade thin.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Tuesday but buying interest remained thin, traders said.

They said olein was quoted at 1,460-65 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening. But offers were also heard at 1,455 rupiah. Crude palm oil was done at 1,251 rupiah/kg at a tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan on Monday.

"The market was rather slow, with BULOG continuing with its market operations," one trader said. "BULOG is selling olein at 1,450 rupiah/kg and my estimate is that it has sold some 10,000 tonnes so far."

A BULOG spokesman had said the market operations, to put a lid on cooking oil prices during the current Moslem Ramadan fasting month, would end on Wednesday. He said the selling would resume in the first week of February ahead of Eid al-Fitr.
Another trader said the market operations had been able to contain local olein prices, which did not seem to react very much to a price rally in Malaysia on Monday.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Tirta Gama would leave the North Sumatran port for Semarang with 1,900 tonnes of palm olein on Wednesday.
